title: Alice's bit is recovered on disjoint samples
statement: Let $\omega$ be a hard-distribution sample whose induced input pair, Alice's set $X(\omega)$ and Bob's set $Y(\omega)$, are disjoint. Then for every coordinate $i$, Alice's bit read off from the disjoint coordinate-pair generated at $i$ agrees with Alice's bit at $i$ under $\omega$.
hypotheses_covered: sample lies in the disjoint event (X and Y are disjoint)
the coordinate i ranges over all Fin n
replaced: On disjoint samples, the generated coordinate vector recovers Alice's input bit at every coordinate.
